subject: Operations
title: Blockchain for Transparency
description: A short lesson to help you apply Blockchain for Transparency.

hook.text: A consumer scans a QR code on coffee beans and sees every step: farm, mill, shipper, roaster. Blockchain did that.

buildup.text: Blockchain creates an immutable, shared record of transactions across multiple parties without a central authority.

discovery.text: In operations, it enables traceability, fraud prevention, automated payments, and proof of ethical sourcing.

twist.text: Blockchain is overhyped for many uses. It's most valuable where trust is low and traceability is critical.

climax.text: De Beers tracks diamonds from mine to retail using blockchain—eliminating conflict diamond concerns with proof.

punchline.text: When trust is low, let the blockchain verify.

quiz.question: When is blockchain most valuable in operations?
options: When trust is low and traceability is critical
